description.en: The description of the Edge Routine.

description.zh: Routine函数名, 同一个账号下命名唯一。
description.en: The name of the Edge Routine. The name must be unique within an Alibaba Cloud account.

descriptions.zh:
> - 入参必须符合EnvConf的各项值规范。函数的描述，长度不允许超过50个字符。
> - 该接口仅能指定Production和Staging环境。
> - API调用频率：100次/秒。
descriptions.en:
> - The request parameters must comply with the value specifications for EnvConf. The function description cannot exceed 50 characters.
>
> - You can specify only the Production and Staging environments.
>
> - The API call frequency is limited to 100 calls per second.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dcdn create-routine --name test --description the_description_of_this_routine --env-conf production={"SpecName":"50ms"} staging={"SpecName":"50ms"} --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dcdn CreateRoutine --region cn-hangzhou --Description the_description_of_this_routine --EnvConf '{"production":{"SpecName":"50ms"},"staging":{"SpecName":"50ms"}}' --Name test
